chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umeyr, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Salama ibn Muhraz, who said:
Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said to me: 'Adhere to Al-Thareed, for I did not find anything more suitable than it.'

key_terms.أَوْفَقَ: More suitable, more appropriate, or more in accordance with benefit
key_terms.الثَّرِيد: A traditional dish consisting of bread soaked in broth or meat sauce

ai.seo_question: What is the recommended food according to Imam Al-Sadiq in this hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) highlights Al-Thareed as the most suitable food, reflecting the Prophetic tradition of valuing simple, nourishing meals that aid digestion and spiritual clarity. This recommendation underscores the Shia emphasis on moderation in diet, where food serves not only as physical sustenance but also as a means to maintain health for worship and daily duties.
